text:
```yaml
name: E2E Flow Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  e2e-flows:
    if: ${{ vars.E2E_FLOWS_ENABLED == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: e2e
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 8

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Start ngrok tunnel
        uses: ngrok/setup-ngrok@v1
        with:
          auth_token: ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          port: 3000

      - name: Run E2E flow tests
        env:
          E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}
          E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}
          NGROK_URL: ${{ env.NGROK_URL }}
        run: pnpm test-e2e:flows
```
